description: One outbox ping record (server/outbox.py). The outbox file is the cross-process source of truth; every public operation reloads it first. Coalescing is by pending job id + ping kind. Ack adds acked_at; voiding adds void_reason. Reading or listing never acknowledges.

state.description: pending at creation; acked and voided are the terminal states.

title: Outbox ping (state/outbox.json element)
